sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as main
  participant Init as app_init
  participant LWIP as AppLwipThread
  participant Netif as LwIP Netif1
  participant Client as TCP echo client
  participant Server as TCP echo server
  participant Peer as TCP echo peer
  participant UART as USART console

  Boot->>Init: Initialize logger and start LwIP, server, and client tasks
  Init->>UART: APP_LOG output through printf and basic stdio
  Init->>LWIP: app_lwip_init creates task
  Init->>Server: app_tcp_echo_server_start creates task
  Init->>Client: app_tcp_echo_client_start creates task
  LWIP->>Netif: Initialize LwIP, add Netif1, and set interface up
  alt Link is up
    Netif->>LWIP: Link callback starts DHCP and timeout timer
  else Link is down
    Netif->>LWIP: Link callback stops DHCP and timeout timer
  end
  alt DHCP obtains an address before timeout
    Netif->>LWIP: IPv4-valid callback sets IP event
  else DHCP timeout with no address
    LWIP->>Netif: Stop DHCP and apply configured manual IPv4 settings
    Netif->>LWIP: IPv4-valid callback sets IP event
  end
  LWIP-->>Client: IP-address event releases client wait
  LWIP-->>Server: IP-address event releases server wait
  Server->>Netif: Bind and listen on TCP port 7
  loop Client connection attempts with 10000 ms delay
    Client->>Netif: Resolve configured target and connect TCP socket
    alt Connection succeeds
      Client->>Peer: Send echo-test buffer
      Peer->>Server: Incoming TCP data when peer is this device's server client
      Server->>Peer: Echo received data
      Peer-->>Client: Return echo data from configured remote peer
      alt Received buffer matches sent buffer
        Client->>UART: Log completed echo
      else Connection or echo operation fails
        Client->>UART: Log error
      end
    else Connection fails
      Client->>UART: Log connection error
    end
  end
